== Summary ==
Identified: none. Left: the selfie-taker in a blue polo, the same face as the ship's-wheel traveler in [[:File:2022 European Championship Team Wales 1.jpg]] and [[:File:2022 European Championship Team Wales 2.jpg]]. Back: the teammate with glasses, a reddish beard, and a tan fleece vest (same man as [[:File:2022 European Championship Team Wales 2.jpg]] and [[:File:2022 European Championship Team Wales 18.jpg]]). Right: a bald man in sunglasses and a grey McLaren polo (same polo as [[:File:2022 European Championship Team Wales 27.jpg]]). Sunglasses hide the eyes, so this is not locked to [[Kevin Jaap]]. Faces unlabeled.
Team Wales in the car at the start of the trip.
The [[2022 European Championship]] weekend in Bochum, Germany, from the "Team Wales Photo Log" thread.
